product_family: Fetcher: AI-powered talent sourcing and recruitment platform for recruiters and hiring managers to identify, engage, and source candidates at scale.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Fetcher holds SOC 2 Type 2 certification, which evaluates adherence to five trust service principles: security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy. CTO Jeremy Martin states: 'At Fetcher, we recognize the importance of data security and privacy. This certification isn't just a badge—it's a living testament to our commitment to prioritizing your robust security and governance requirements.'

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification found in vendor domain or available documentation.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Fetcher states it is '100% compliant' with GDPR. The company operates under EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (DPF), UK Extension to the EU-U.S. DPF, and Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework. Fetcher uses Standard Contractual Clauses issued by the European Commission for personal data transfers and commits to responding to data erasure requests within 72 hours.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance. HIPAA is not mentioned in vendor's privacy policy, terms, or trust documentation. Fetcher is a recruitment platform, not a healthcare tool, and outside HIPAA's scope.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification in vendor documentation.

privacy.ai_training_note: Terms of Service do not explicitly address whether customer data is used to train AI models. Terms permit data transfer to third-party integrations (ATS, CRM, email) when subscribers authorize, but no statement on internal AI training practices. Recommend contacting vendor for explicit clarification.
privacy.data_region: AWS (Amazon Web Services) - vendor states 'meets rigorous international security standards' but specific regions not publicly documented

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256 encryption for all data at rest; talent lead data encrypted with unique key per record

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: HTTPS/TLS for data in transit (standard practice, confirmed by GDPR compliance statement)

security.name: Password security
security.value: Industry-standard hashing and salting using bcrypt

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Amazon Web Services (AWS) with continuous security audits and geographically distributed compliance certifications

security.name: Data subject rights response
security.value: Data erasure requests responded to within 72 hours; unsubscribe and objection requests honored for direct marketing

security.name: Incident response
security.value: SOC 2 Type 2 certification includes ability to detect and respond to security incidents or system failures quickly and effectively

security.name: Responsible disclosure
security.value: Responsible Disclosure policy available for security researchers

products.name: Fetcher (core platform)
products.data_scope: Professional candidate data (job history, skills, LinkedIn profiles) sourced from professional networks and third-party vendors; candidate data retained for one year with annual updates; customer contact information retained during contract validity
products.notes: AI-powered platform for recruiters and hiring managers to identify, screen, and engage candidates. Integrates with ATS, CRM, email, and Slack. Supports both inbound and outbound sourcing workflows.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription-based SaaS (specific tiers not detailed in available docs)
compare.data_residency: AWS multi-region, specific default region not publicly specified

flags: No ISO 27001 certification (not uncommon for growth-stage SaaS, but common for enterprise procurement)

AI training posture on customer data not explicitly documented—terms permit third-party integrations but do not address internal model training. Recommend vendor clarification for procurement due diligence.
No dedicated trust center; compliance information distributed across privacy policy, help docs, and blog posts (minor operational concern, not a security concern)
No HIPAA or PCI DSS compliance (appropriate for recruitment use case, but may limit enterprise sales in healthcare/payments sectors)
